subject.title: feat(system-agent): agentic cached caretaker greeting with quick actions

question: Should the system agent automatically invoke the configured model for an empty-session caretaker welcome when its grounded system facts change?
rationale: This is a new default product behavior with metered inference and first-open latency implications; the open umbrella proposal describes the feature but does not itself establish final maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Approve the bounded caretaker contract
options.body: Accept automatic cached greeting inference as a system-agent behavior, with the deterministic fallback and fact-change gate retained.

options.title: Keep greetings deterministic
options.body: Reject automatic model invocation on welcome and retain only the template plus structured quick actions.

options.title: Defer pending broader overhaul review
options.body: Pause this phase until the umbrella system-agent direction receives an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded caretaker contract
recommendation.body: Accept automatic cached greeting inference as a system-agent behavior, with the deterministic fallback and fact-change gate retained.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identifiable recent contributor for both the parent system-agent proposal and the adjacent merged gateway session work.
